entry.name: Image
entry.label: Path of the image the rain takes its colours from. Empty: classic green.

entry.name: CellHeight
entry.label: Height of one glyph cell in pixels. Smaller cells give a finer picture and, at the same speed, more steps a second.

entry.name: Speed
entry.label: How fast the rain falls: pixels per second for the fastest drops. The slowest fall at a third of it. A smaller cell therefore steps more often.

entry.name: TrailFloor
entry.label: How dark a trail may get, 0 to 1. 0: it fades to black. Above 0: every glyph stays at least this bright, so the image stays visible between the drops.

entry.name: Lift
entry.label: Brightens dark images, 0 to 1. 0: glyphs are as bright as the image is there. 1: every glyph at full brightness in its image's hue. Nothing clips in between.

entry.name: Glide
entry.label: How the rain moves. 0: each glyph lights up as a whole, cell by cell. 1: the light moves smoothly over the glyphs. 2: the head falls smoothly as a glyph of its own (smoothest, the head leaves the grid).

entry.name: Drops
entry.label: Drops falling in each column at once, 1 to 4.

entry.name: TrailLength
entry.label: Trail lengths are scaled by this. 1: from 8 rows up to 70 % of the screen's height on average; faster drops leave longer trails.

entry.name: TrailCurve
entry.label: How a trail fades from the head. 1: evenly; more: quickly after the head, with a long dim tail; less: stays bright, then drops at the end.

entry.name: Glow
entry.label: Brightness of the soft halo around each drop's head, 0 to 1. 0: no halo.

entry.name: GlowSize
entry.label: Radius of the halo, in glyph heights.

entry.name: LogFrameRate
entry.label: Write the measured frame rate to plasmashell's log every two seconds. For ./run.sh perf.
